title: fix(studio): keep a refused publish on its Pending changes entry, and end "Show me" on the input
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ81WNJr1LMBXbQEggU6VRywj)_
Fixes #26730

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 发布被拒后，原因留在「待发布的变更」对应条目上直到修复，用作者能看懂的话说；「Show me」把焦点落到出问题的输入框。
- 为什么改：以前拒绝只是约 4 秒的提示，里面是引擎内部文字，面板什么也不留，「Show me」也不聚焦。
- 风险与回滚：只改 Studio 前端与文案，不动发布判定、暂存编辑保护和服务端文字；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：StudioDesignSurface.tsx 的 doPublish 与 useShowInputFocus；metadataError.ts 的 publishRefusal；DraftChangesPanel.tsx 的 renderEntryNote。
- 两分钟验证：运行 Verification 节第一条命令，应见 7 个测试文件、26 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The refusal stays on its entry.** `doPublish` keeps each causal failure of a refused publish (every `failed[]` element that is not a `BATCH_ABORTED` sibling, per ADR-0067 D2) in surface state, keyed by canonical type and name. The surface hands the Pending changes sheet a new `renderEntryNote` prop, and the entry shows the refusal strip under its row until it is resolved: the draft is saved again (`onDraftSaved` now names the draft it wrote), a later publish lets it through, or the ledger no longer lists the draft. The package-less scope keeps its refusals the same way.
- **Worded by the refusal reader.** New `publishRefusal` in `metadataError.ts` places a failure's issues with the locators a refused save uses. A gate issue path is rooted at the snapshot entry (`objects.NAME.…`, `flows[0].…`), so the first two segments are dropped. The draft the publish judged is read back (`getDraft`, best-effort) to place them. The sentence carries the server's problem only where the designer has its own words for it (`translateValidationMessage`), otherwise it says Details tell what to change. The raw lines stay under Details, verbatim. A failure with no issues reads `Not published: REASON`, with its text unchanged.
- **The toast points at the sheet.** Its title counts the items that need a change, its description names each with its sentence, and a rolled-back batch adds one line saying the other drafts wait. It quotes no engine text.
- **"Show me" ends on the input.** `useShowInputFocus` focuses the control the inspector labels with the refusal's `input` (or the inspector's first control when it names none), once the selection is drawn, giving up after 3 s. This applies in Data (field inspector, actions panel), Automations (step configuration) and Interfaces. Interfaces had no "Show me": a dashboard widget and a report's own inputs are now placed (`leafIssueLocator`), and "Show me" opens the widget, or the report's properties, with the focus on the input.
- **Rows.** The `studio` namespace gains the sentences in `en` and `zh`, shipped as a patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

The card measured three gaps, each confirmed before this change. A refused publish showed only a ~4 s toast of `formatPublishFailures` text, which quoted the functional-completeness rule's engine prose. Nothing kept `failed[]` after the toast. "Show me" selected its target but never moved the focus, and the Interfaces strip had no "Show me" at all. The ruling (6447119250) asks for the refusal to stay in the panel until resolved, in author terms, with the field focused.

## Tests

- `metadataError.publishRefusal-26730.test.ts`: the summary-field rule's engine text is placed on the field and its input with no engine text in the sentence; Details keep the raw line; flow (`flows[0]`), dashboard widget and report placements; no draft means an unlocated sentence; an issue-less failure reads as its text; `zh` sentence after `loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`; only causal failures are kept.
- `StudioDesignSurface.publishRefusal-26730.test.tsx` (real surface, sheet probe, toasts mocked): a refused publish leaves the refusal on its entry, worded by the reader, with the raw text under Details; the aborted sibling has none; re-saving clears it; a publish that lets it through clears it; a successful publish shows no refusal.
- `DraftChangesPanel.entryNote-26730.test.tsx`: the real sheet draws the host's note under the right entry, asked with the folded type; no host note, no note.
- `DataPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx`, `AutomationsPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx`, `InterfacesPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx`: "Show me" leaves `document.activeElement` on the named input: a field's Label, an action's label from another view, a step's Title, a step's inspector, a dashboard widget's Title, a report's Label.
- `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx` updated: the refused batch's toast title is now the count sentence, and the item and its reason are in the description.

## Acceptance notes

- The note on a Pending changes entry has no "Show me": the sheet reaches an item through its own link, and a strip's "Show me" opens an input only in the pillar that holds the item. The pillars' strips carry it.
- Held edits (objectui#11786) keep their notice and their "Show me" as before.
- Refusals are keyed by canonical type and name, so two members of one bundle (an `email_template` pair) share one note.
- A `BATCH_ABORTED` sibling gets no note: it publishes once the causal item is fixed.
- No change to publish gating, the held-edit guard, server text, or `formatMetadataError`. `formatPublishFailures` is unchanged; the AI chat page still uses it.
- Template exception: the body follows the os-dev section order, with the template's headings (What changes, Why, Verification, the two declaration lines, Human Minimum) folded in.

## Verification

Head `330e5fef`, base `5ec398dc`; the branch merges cleanly with the current `main`.

1. The new and updated tests: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.publishRefusal-26730.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.publishRefusal-26730.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.entryNote-26730.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.showMeFocus-26730.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx` gives Test Files 7 passed (7), Tests 26 passed (26).
2. Every Studio and preview suite at the head: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design packages/app-shell/src/preview` gives Test Files 274 passed (274), Tests 1950 passed (1950).
3. `@object-ui/i18n`: `tsc --noEmit` exit 0; `vitest run packages/i18n` gives Test Files 89 passed (89), Tests 1373 passed, 13 skipped.
4. `@object-ui/app-shell`: `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0; eslint over the touched files reports 0 errors, and its one new warning (a state write in an effect) was removed by deriving the shown refusals instead.

<details><summary>Ablations (2, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs with a restore trap)</summary>

- Drop the kept-failures state (delete the `setPublishRefusals(new Map(…))` line in `doPublish`): `StudioDesignSurface.publishRefusal-26730.test.tsx` goes red, 3 failed and 1 passed (the passing one is the control, a successful publish shows no refusal). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Drop the focus move (delete `control.focus();` in `useShowInputFocus`): the three showMeFocus files go red, 6 of 6 failed. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>
